blockScoping: block CSS scoped under .<name> (decorateBlock adds .block + data-block-name, wraps in div.<name>-wrapper, section gains .<name>-container)

buttonMapping.hoverWipe: decorateButtonWipes(root) (exported from scripts.js, run in decorateMain) appends span.before[data-label] + span.after to every a.button; blocks that create .button anchors call it themselves

classNaming: canon BEM class names in kebab-case: __ and -- become - (site-nav__menu__title -> site-nav-menu-title, button--primary -> button-primary, mkto-form__row--check -> mkto-form-row-check); stylelint selector-class-pattern is kebab-case
cellNormalization: wrapTextNodes folds a cell whose first child is not P/PRE/UL/OL/PICTURE/TABLE/H1-6 (or a media-led cell) into one
bodyGate: body { display: none } / body.appear { display: flex } (the canon body is a flex column)
contentRoot: the canon .site-content / #valtech-wrapper rules live on <main> (flex 1 0 auto, mobile padding-top var(--header-h-mobile) + main::before fixed strip); header.js gives <main> id valtech-content + tabindex -1 for the skip link
chromeReservation: body > header { height: var(--nav-height) } with --nav-height 1px < 64rem, 65px >= 64rem; header/footer blocks hidden until data-block-status=loaded
breakpoints: source own: 58.75rem (940) layout, 64rem (1024) chrome, 96rem (1536) wide; stylelint writes them in range notation (width >= 64rem)
fonts: styles/fonts.css: Soehne 300/300i/400/700 + ValtechNeue 300/400 self-hosted (R-02, as the prototypes ship); LiberationFallback local() alias in styles.css; loaded by loadFonts() (eager >= 900px or session flag, always in loadLazy); no font preload in head.html

icons.sprite: /icons/sprite.svg — UI symbols (search, global, close, arrow-down, arrow-link, arrow-right, social, plus/minus(-thin), cross, location, chevron-left, carret-down, linkedin, linkedin-footer, email, insight, news, whitepaper, facebook)
icons.flags: /icons/flags.svg — 2-letter flags icon-xx (loaded on first location-chooser open)

favicon: /favicon.ico (captured source favicon, served from the repo root; no head.html line needed)

chrome.mechanism: scripts.js chromePath(name): page metadata `nav` / `footer` wins; else a page under /es-es/ loads /es-es/nav + /es-es/footer, every other page /nav + /footer; scripts.js also sets <html lang> from the same prefix (es on /es-es/, else en)
chrome.robots: every chrome document carries a metadata row Robots | noindex
chrome.navModel: sections classified by content: brand (:valtech-logo: link) | menu (one list, top items = labels, nested list = links) | tools (search link -> icon aria-label, #-link -> side tab, other link -> mobile Contact Us bar) | locations (title p, global link p, list of regions with :xx: flag-led place links)
chrome.footerModel: brand (:valtech-logo-footer:) | nav list | stamp images (a link-only paragraph after an image links it) | legal list (a # link = cookie-settings reset) | social list (links led by :icon-name: icons, text = link title)

pageMetadata.nav-active: label text of the top-level nav item marked active (coral marker + aria-current) — /es-es/ pages carry it per the source (mostly Perspectivas); English pages captured have none
pageMetadata.theme: ie-hub-page -> body.ie-hub-page: ie-hub chrome variant (icons in the top bar, search hidden, no side tab, footer without side column) for the /la-empresa-inteligente/ hub pages
pageMetadata.nav / footer: path of an alternate chrome document

chrome.behaviour: stardust/chrome/header-contract.json (source): >= 64rem labels open the drop-down on hover and on click, outside click closes, leaving the nav closes a hover-opened drop-down; location chooser toggles with a wipe, aria-expanded, scroll lock, Escape closes + focus returns; < 64rem burger -> full-screen menu with accordions + fixed Contact Us bar; sticky bar slides in on scroll up (ready-to-fixed-menu / fixed-menu)

sharedCanonClasses: styles.css carries the shared canon: type ramp, themes (.dark-theme .blue-theme .white-theme), buttons, skip link, breadcrumbs (.site-breadcrumbs*, separator nbsp+/), carousel controls (.carousel-btn*, .carousel-dots, .carousel-native), contact band (.contact-us-form*), Marketo form dark (in the band) + light (elsewhere, .marketo-form-block*/.mkto-form*)
notShipped: the hidden acquired-brand redirect modals (div.modal-redirect) are not rendered — they never display without a redirected visit
